title: Infrastructure Services
metaDescription: Sato's established infrastructure practice: construction and civil, electrical, mechanical, and water resources and environmental engineering, delivering since 1997.

body: Our established infrastructure practice, delivering since 1997.

Our scope covers all aspects of civil engineering design and construction: roads, dams, irrigation development, buildings and water resources development. We own and operate our own plant, including a borehole drilling rig, so we mobilise without waiting on hired equipment and keep control of quality and programme on site.
The four disciplines below are delivered by the same teams and under the same project management. Most Sato contracts draw on more than one of them.

sections.heading: Planning infrastructure work?
sections.body: Tell us the scope and we will show you comparable work and the team that would deliver it.
